activation_condition: Populate at M6 open when first PPL miss is recorded and analyzed
miss_threshold: ≥2σ contradiction OR explicit CONTRADICTED outcome on MED/HIGH confidence prediction

miss_entry.prediction_domain: string — career | health | relationships | finance | spiritual | other
miss_entry.outcome_session: string — session_id that recorded the outcome
miss_entry.signal_chain: array of MSR.NNN signal IDs active in the prediction
miss_entry.dbn_nodes_affected: array of DBN node IDs from dbn_params_v1_0.json

H1_signal_weight.description: string — which signal weight(s) may be incorrect
H1_signal_weight.counterfactual_prediction: float — what the model would have predicted with corrected weight

H2_topology.description: string — which DBN edge or node may be missing/wrong

H3_prior.description: string — which prior specification may be too strong

miss_entry.recommended_action_target: string — specific signal, edge, or prior to address
miss_entry.analysis_session: string — session_id that performed counterfactual analysis

n1_disclaimer: VALIDITY NOTICE: Miss analysis derives from a single native (n=1) corpus. Per MACRO_PLAN §3.5.A Principle 1 — n=1 validity disclaimer applies to all entries.
